title: Gate review record
description: The payload carried in the `detail` of an approval-requested or approval-granted journal event. A review that cannot name the artifacts it examined, by hash, is not a review.

path.description: Path relative to the episode directory. Never absolute: a record that names a reviewer's home directory cannot be checked anywhere else.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the file's bytes at the moment of review.

evidence.description: What was examined to reach this status — a path, a measurement, a tool invocation.

decision.description: There is deliberately no 'rejected'. JOURNAL_EVENTS has no approval-rejected type, and encoding a rejection inside an approval-granted event would contradict itself on disk. See avg-qr4.3.

then.description: An approval must name at least one artifact. Approving nothing is the bug this issue exists to remove.
